promptLatex: A card is drawn at random from a standard 52-card deck. A card is worth its number if it is a 2 through 9 and worth 10 if it is an ace, jack, queen or king. What is the expected value of the card?
hintLatex: Add the total value of all 52 cards and divide by 52.
The cards worth $2$ through $9$ total $4(2+3+\cdots+9) = 176$, the tens contribute $40$, and the 12 face cards contribute $120$.
The whole deck totals $336$, so the mean is $\frac{336}{52}$.
solutionLatex:
The eight values from $2$ through $9$ each appear on four cards, so they contribute $4(2 + 3 + \cdots + 9) = 4 \cdot 44 = 176$. The four tens contribute $40$, and the twelve ace, jack, queen and king cards contribute $12 \cdot 10 = 120$.

The deck totals $176 + 40 + 120 = 336$ over $52$ cards, so

E = \frac{336}{52} = \frac{84}{13}.
